translation: You have a right to your work, never to its fruits.
Evenness of mind is called yoga.
Better your own duty done imperfectly than another's done well.
Lift yourself by yourself; do not let yourself sink.
Pleasure and pain come and go. Endure them, Arjuna.

sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
translation: Whenever righteousness declines, I come forth.

sanskrit: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।
translation: Like a lamp in a windless place, the steady mind does not flicker.
Dwelling on objects breeds attachment to them.
Dear to me is the one who neither troubles the world nor is troubled by it.
All this, whatever moves in this world, is pervaded by the Divine.

sanskrit: असतो मा सद्गमय। तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय।
translation: Lead me from the unreal to the real, from darkness to light.
Speak the truth. Walk in righteousness.

sanskrit: आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतः।
translation: Let noble thoughts come to us from every side.
Yoga is the stilling of the mind's movements.
Let go of all else and take refuge in Me alone.
Non-violence is the highest duty.
Steadiness, forgiveness, restraint, honesty, purity, mastery of the senses.
That thou art.

sanskrit: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः।
translation: Acting without attachment, offering the work itself, one stays untouched.
Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
Steadied in wisdom, one is freed from both good and bad outcomes.
